revisions.name: Padded Armor
revisions.summary: Padded Armor (Light Armor): Armor Class 11 + Dex modifier; Strength —; Stealth Disadvantage; 8 lb.; 5 GP.

effects.text: Light Armor (1 Minute to Don or Doff). The table’s Armor Class column tells you what your base AC is when you wear a type of armor. If the table shows “Disadvantage” in the Stealth column for an armor type, the wearer has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. If you wear Light, Medium, or Heavy armor and lack training with it, you have Disadvantage on any D20 Test that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can’t cast spells.

revisions.name: Chain Mail
revisions.summary: Chain Mail (Heavy Armor): Armor Class 16; Strength Str 13; Stealth Disadvantage; 55 lb.; 75 GP.

effects.text: Heavy Armor (10 Minutes to Don and 5 Minutes to Doff). The table’s Armor Class column tells you what your base AC is when you wear a type of armor. If the table shows a Strength score in the Strength column for an armor type, that armor reduces the wearer’s speed by 10 feet unless the wearer has a Strength score equal to or higher than the listed score. If the table shows “Disadvantage” in the Stealth column for an armor type, the wearer has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. If you wear Light, Medium, or Heavy armor and lack training with it, you have Disadvantage on any D20 Test that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can’t cast spells.

revisions.name: Shield
revisions.summary: Shield: Armor Class +2; Strength —; Stealth —; 6 lb.; 10 GP.

effects.text: Shield (Utilize Action to Don or Doff). You gain the Armor Class benefit of a Shield only if you have training with it. A creature can wear only one suit of armor at a time and wield only one Shield at a time.
